system.description:
At the start of each scene, choose one strategy: Cunning, Stealth, or Survival. Until the scene ends, you gain the keyed feature:

  • Cunning: When you Utilize an Experience, you can mark a Stress instead of spending a Hope. If you do, double your Experience modifier for that roll.

  • Stealth: Any time you would be Hidden, you are instead Shrouded.

  • Survival: When you take damage, you can mark 2 Stress to mark 1 fewer Hit Points.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v2.0 Mind
